propositions: Jira Data Center rate-limiting headers (Retry-After) are not honoured; 429 responses cause hard failures instead of being retried
The transport's _with_connection_retry function does not handle HTTP 429 responses and treats JIRAError as non-retryable across all 15 call sites including mutations
Retrying 429s on mutations through the shared choke point would reintroduce duplicate-issue creation defects because responses cannot distinguish server-side-started writes from gate rejections
The transport module is at locked 800-line capacity with 11 lines headroom, forcing retry/error logic extraction before 429 policy can be added
429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only via per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF, with jitter-then-clamp delay arithmetic and exhaustion bounded by BackendHTTPError(code=429)
High-volume per-issue reads like get_comment_map call _with_connection_retry directly bypassing _call_logged, requiring retry-opt-in to reach multiple call paths
